info.title: NoiseFloor MCP
info.description: Statistical checks on observations you supply: whether a change may be noise, peek-safe A/B comparisons, forecast intervals and evidence gaps. Send only public, synthetic or explicitly authorized data. Results are descriptive statistics, not proof of causality, guaranteed intervals or trading advice.

post.description: Sends Model Context Protocol messages to the hosted NoiseFloor server over Streamable HTTP. The agent runtime manages the session, so makers do not call this operation directly.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Media types the MCP server may return.
